# AiCraft

> AiCraft is a micro-consultancy that builds workflow automation, hybrid search, and data tools for small businesses, nonprofits, and local government teams. One to two clients at a time, clear scopes, plain language.

AiCraft is run by a data scientist and designer with 25+ years of experience in AI, NLP, and data engineering — including enterprise-scale and federal-grade AI systems. The practice focuses on small organizations that need real leverage from their data but can't hire a full data department.

AiCraft builds agentic AI, but deliberately does not lead with it. A small organization usually needs a tailored, sustainable solution that is cheap to keep running — most often a well-built workflow automation and high-quality search. Agents are built when a process is genuinely open-ended enough to warrant one.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, process, and recent knowledge articles.

- [Knowledge](/knowledge): Articles on AI, data, and web topics relevant to small organizations.
- [About](/about): Background on the practice and founder.
- [Contact](/contact): How to start a project conversation.

## Services

- **Workflow Automation** — Repetitive, multi-step processes (intake, triage, routing, follow-ups, data entry) automated end to end, with human approval gates at the decisions that need judgment. The primary offering.
- **Search & Knowledge Retrieval** — Hybrid search combining keyword (lexical) precision with semantic (vector) understanding, across structured and unstructured data together. Searchable archives, records, and document collections, with retrieval evaluation.
- **Dashboards & Decision Tools** — Data visualization and reporting tools built around the actual questions an organization needs to answer.
- **Data & AI Strategy** — Problem framing, analysis of alternatives, and information architecture. Identifying the smallest useful solution — including when the answer is not AI at all.
- **Connected Web Presence** — Modern web frameworks, forms that feed clean data into real systems, and on-page search grounded in the client's own content.
- **Agentic AI** — Custom AI assistants and agentic workflows (Hermes and similar frameworks) with guardrails, logging, and evaluation. Built when a process genuinely warrants an agent rather than a simpler automation.

## About this site

Built with Astro. Content is written and maintained by the AiCraft founder. Knowledge articles reflect real experience and are not AI-generated.
